page.layout: One page of text, single column, numbered list of titles in the upper and middle part. A library stamp sits in the centre-lower area and show-through text appears faintly in the lower part and right side; neither is transcribed.

main_text.p: 6. Modesta responsio ad Martini Lutheri institutionem de Eucharistia, cui adiuncta est responsio ad syngramma ecclesiastarum in Suevia ex Germanico in Latinum versa Ludovico Lauathero interprete.
7. Secunda responsio ad eundem ex Germanico eodem authore in Latinum versa.
8. Tertia responsio ad eiusdem confessionem de coena Christi, e Germanica lingua in Latinam versa R. Gualthero interprete.
9. Quid de sacramento veteres senserint, dialogus, cui inserta est epistola Philippi Melachth, quam e Spira Oecolampadio misit, & eiusdem responsio.

page.notes: The faint text in the lower half of the page is show-through from the reverse side and was not transcribed. The library stamp (Stadtbibliothek Zürich) was not transcribed. Line 9 is printed with a fleuron-like numeral "9." and the title "Melachth" is printed as shown.
